page.overview:
Who is Edwell?

Edwell was a 24th century Starfleet captain, born on Gaspar VII.

Edwell had been known to Commander Calvin Hutchinson some years prior to 2369. According to him Edwell was "fascinating" and though he was born on Gaspar VII, he didn't look like it. ()
